as it is said: 'hope deferred makes the heart sick' (Prov 13:12)

as it is said: 'but desire fulfilled is a tree of life' (Prov 13:12)

no difficulty: this [R' Yochanan's heartache] where he prolongs and looks into it

[second of the four:] good deeds need strengthening

'and be courageous': in good deeds
prayer, from where? 'hope in the Lord; be strong and let your heart take courage, and hope in the Lord' (Ps 27:14)
derech eretz, from where? 'be strong and let us strengthen ourselves for our people...' (II Sam 10:12)
